targetSignatureHeader.title: Signature Header
targetSignatureHeader.description: Specify the HTTP header that will contain the generated HMAC signature

schemeType.title: Generation Type
schemeType.description: By default, this policy will generate the HMAC signature only against the HTTP body or Message content.  Change this option if you need to include additional headers (as well as the body/message) in the signature generation.

oneOf.title: HTTP Body or Message Content (only)
oneOf.description: By default, this policy will generate the HMAC signature using only the HTTP body or Message content

oneOf.title: HTTP Body or Message Content + Header(s)
oneOf.description: Generate the HMAC signature using both the HTTP body or Message content, pre-fixed with additional header(s) values

headersDelimiter.title: Delimiter
headersDelimiter.description: Specify a delimiter to separate each header and the body/message

headers.title: HTTP/Message Headers
headers.description: List of existing HTTP or Message headers to prepend their values to the body/message for generating the HMAC signature

timestampValidity.title: Replay Protection
timestampValidity.description: Optionally generate a timestamp, include it in the HMAC signature, and expose it in a header so the receiver can reject stale or replayed requests/messages.

oneOf.title: Disabled
oneOf.description: No timestamp is generated or signed.

oneOf.title: Enabled
oneOf.description: Generate a timestamp, sign it along with the body/message, and expose it in a header.

targetTimestampHeader.title: Timestamp Header
targetTimestampHeader.description: Specify the HTTP/Message header that will contain the generated timestamp (epoch seconds)

delimiter.title: Delimiter
delimiter.description: Specify a delimiter to separate the timestamp from the rest of the signed content

secret.title: Secret
secret.description: The secret key used to generate the HMAC signature
